note: Community cheat-intelligence list. AsyncAnalyzer auto-downloads this on start (unless -NoUpdate). knownCheatHashes = confirmed cheat SHA1s. knownGoodHashes = known-legit SHA1s. packagePaths = distinctive cheat Java packages. clientTokens = distinctive cheat-client filename tokens. downloadDomains = cheat download sites. processNames = EXTERNAL ghost clients that run as their own process and never appear in the mods folder. Keep clientTokens and processNames distinctive/compound (e.g. 'ghostclient', never bare 'ghost') so legit mods and normal programs are never false-flagged. moduleNames = cheat MODULE names confirmed in two independent open-source cheat clients (Wurst @4e9fd5a, Meteor @8038a0a) AND checked for collisions with real mods - names like Timer/Step/Reach or VeinMiner/Freecam are deliberately excluded because legit mods use them. scanPaths = extra folders every client should always scan on top of whatever Minecraft is open (a machine-specific list can also go in %APPDATA%\\AsyncAnalyzer\\paths.txt, one path per line). Everyone who runs the tool then benefits.

telemetry.note: Team scan-history + shared learning. Set enabled=true and fill endpoint (your backend URL from server/README.md) + key (WRITE_KEY) to have every run upload its result to your dashboard. The tool shows an upload notice to the scanned person. Set enabled=false to turn it off for everyone instantly.
